notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the recreation, which does not yet pass the dist gate (see 730-002_DiffBodyB.scad's header), and the revised one draws the print fits listed there: the press clearance on the 6703 seats, journal and tube, the running clearance off the shaft and the bevel toes, and the front 6703 seat deeper by the shorter shaft journal. The J4 tunnel runs along X at (y, z) = (-21, 21) and the column along Z at (x, y) = (21, -21). Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
